pages.text: Pack magic resistance before you enter — Blue Skies' two T2 dimensions, Everbright (light/order) and Everdawn (dark/chaos), fight with elemental damage throughout.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Elemental damage in Blue Skies bypasses standard armor. Magic resistance (Sorcery tree, Battlemage class) is more valuable here than raw armor stats.$(br2)$(bold)Bosses:$() Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, and Arachnarch each drop a Simply Swords unique.
$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$() Blue Skies chest loot banks Exploration tokens at a slightly higher rate than Twilight Forest — the dimensions are dense, and looting them pays accordingly.

$(bold)No guide book.$() Blue Skies is exploration-driven. Both dimensions — the Everbright and the Everdawn — contain dungeon loot and boss encounters that guide you forward naturally. JEI covers all crafting recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Next: find a Gatekeeper's house in the Overworld — the Gatekeeper sells the keys to both dimensions' dungeons.$()
